_comment: Structural snapshot taken by hand on 2026-08-28. Node bodies are not here - run n8n/export-workflows.mjs for those.
name: Family Council v2 - KB Ingestion (Google Drive)

settings._comment: Execution data is NOT retained on success. n8n stores its own state in SQLite on an Azure Files SMB share, which corrupted on 2026-08-28 and took the chatbot offline. Every saved run is a write to that file. Failed runs are still saved in full - those are the ones worth keeping.

nodes.name: KB Config
nodes.critical: Holds the KB Drive root folder id.

nodes.name: Crawl Next Level
nodes.critical: splice(0, 1) - ONE folder per Drive query. Batching 5+ makes Drive return an EMPTY list with no error; subfolders were invisible for a month in 2026. Never raise this.

nodes.name: List Folder Children
nodes.critical: authentication MUST be oAuth2. Set to serviceAccount it silently returns 0 files, because the service account has no access to the personal Drive holding the KB.

nodes.name: Absorb Level
nodes.critical: Pushes every discovered subfolder back onto pendingFolders. This is what makes the crawl recurse to ALL depths.

nodes.name: More Folders To Crawl?
nodes.critical: Loops back to Crawl Next Level until no folders remain.

nodes.name: Upsert Queue
nodes.critical: Re-queues on modified_time OR parent_folder change - a Drive move does not touch modifiedTime but can change the access tag.

nodes.name: Reconcile Deletions
nodes.critical: Safety gate: does nothing if the crawl returned zero files, or if more than 10% (min 20) would be removed. Without it, one broken crawl erases the knowledge base.
